value.behaviour: jsdom tests for the editor flow: selection tracking in AppState, applying colour and highlight to a selection, controls visibility, canvas drawing, persistence exclusion and undo.
rules: 1. Render <Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} /> in beforeEach via render from "./test-utils"; use `const { h } = window;`, API from "./helpers/api", Keyboard/UI from "./helpers/ui", getTextEditor from "./queries/dom".

2. Open the editor on an existing text: API.setElements([text]); API.setSelectedElements([text]); Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.ENTER); const editor = await getTextEditor(). Select with editor.setSelectionRange(start, end) followed by fireEvent.select(editor).
3. Apply styles with act(() => h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionChangeTextRangeColor, "ui", { color })) (and the highlight action); actions are imported from "../actions".

4. For canvas assertions export with exportScene({ type: "canvas", data: { elements, files: {} } }) from "../scene/export" and spy with vi.spyOn on the 2d context prototype's fillText/fillRect, recording `this.fillStyle` at each call.

tests.name: tracks the editor selection in appState
tests.expect: h.state.textEditorSelection equals { elementId: text.id, start: 20, end: 25 }

tests.name: applies a text colour to the selection
tests.expect: element styleRanges equal [{ start: 20, end: 25, color: '#e03131' }]

tests.name: merges a highlight over an overlapping selection
tests.given: after the colour, select [12,22) and apply highlight '#ffec99'

tests.name: transparent clears the colour on the selection
does nothing without an editor or with an empty selection
tests.given: editor closed, and separately a collapsed selection

tests.name: shifts ranges while typing and clears the selection on exit
tests.given: coloured [20,25), then updateTextEditor with 'XX' prepended, then Keyboard.exitTextEditor
tests.expect: styleRanges [{22,27,color}] on the committed element; h.state.textEditorSelection is null

tests.name: shows the selection pickers only while editing
tests.given: a selected text element, before and after pressing Enter
tests.expect: no element with aria-label 'Selection color' / 'Selection highlight' before; both present while editing

tests.name: draws styled runs on canvas
tests.given: text 'ab cd' with color red on [3,5) and highlight on [0,2), exported to canvas
tests.expect: fillText called once per run ('ab', ' ', 'cd') with 'cd' drawn in red; fillRect called with the highlight fillStyle; an unstyled text gets one fillText per line

tests.name: never persists the editor selection
tests.expect: key absent from clearAppStateForLocalStorage, cleanAppStateForExport and clearAppStateForDatabase results and from serializeAsJSON output

tests.name: undo restores the earlier ranges
tests.given: apply a colour while editing, exit the editor, Keyboard.undo()

style_from.reason: imports, render setup, h global and editor helpers

uses.reason: exportScene to canvas and inspecting fillText

value.behaviour: Adds SVG export tests for styled text: tspans with fill, highlight rects before the line's text, unstyled markup unchanged.
rules: 1. Append a new top-level describe "exportToSvg text style ranges" after the exportToSvg describe; build elements with API.createElement({ type: "text", ... }) and add styleRanges by spreading `{ ...el, styleRanges: [...] }`; export with exportScene({ type: "svg", data: { elements, appState: DEFAULT_APP_STATE-like { viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff" }, files: {} }, config: { canvasBackgroundColor: false } }).
2. Query the result with querySelectorAll("text"), ("tspan"), ("rect") and assert attributes; no snapshots.

tests.name: coloured run exports a tspan with its fill
tests.expect: a <tspan> with textContent '120ms' and fill '#e03131'; the other tspans have no fill

tests.name: highlighted run exports a rect before its text
tests.expect: a <rect> with fill '#ffec99' whose next sibling chain reaches the line's <text>, and width > 0

tests.name: dark mode filters run colours
tests.given: the coloured element exported with config theme dark

tests.name: unstyled text exports exactly as before
tests.expect: no <tspan> and no extra <rect>; the <text> textContent equals the line and keeps its text-anchor

uses.reason: exportScene call shape and the dark-mode config option

value.behaviour: Adds editor tests that ranges shift and trim as the textarea text changes, and that the selection clears on submit.
rules: 1. Replace the `import { actionBindText } from "../actions";` line with an import of actionBindText and actionChangeTextRangeColor from "../actions".

2. Append a describe "style ranges" inside the outer describe, before its final closing line; it renders <Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} /> in its own beforeEach like the neighbouring blocks.

tests.name: typing before a range moves it
tests.given: text 'hello world' with color on [6,11) applied through the action while editing, then updateTextEditor('>> hello world')

tests.name: deleting part of a range trims it
typing at the end of a range leaves the new text unstyled
submitting clears textEditorSelection
tests.given: editor open with a selection, Keyboard.exitTextEditor(editor)
